# Daily Banana

> Daily Banana (dailybanana.io, "Banana for scale") is a free daily size-guessing game by Smidgen Games LLC. Each round asks how many of one everyday thing would line up to match another, such as "How many bananas long is a school bus?" Players type a number; points are their accuracy as a percent.

Key facts:
- 6 rounds per daily, 25 seconds each, up to 100 points per round (600 per game).
- Points = the smaller of the guess and the answer divided by the bigger, as a percent. Half or twice the answer scores 50; 10x off scores 10.
- All sizes are approximations: typical averages from publicly available data, rounded. Players should picture an average example of each thing.
- A new daily arrives at midnight in each player's own time zone; everyone gets the same questions for the same daily number.
- Past dailies, with answers, real sizes, average scores and typical guesses, are posted in the archive once each daily has finished everywhere.
- Also: quick play (random questions), 24-hour challenge links to play the same questions as friends, badges, and optional sign-in with Google or Discord. Free, no ads. No AI runs in the game.
